question: In Major League Baseball, how far is the pitcher's plate from the back point of home plate?
answer: The pitcher's plate is 60 feet, 6 inches from the back point of home plate. [7] The rulebook describes the plate as a 24-inch by 6-inch slab of whitened rubber, set 10 inches above the level of home plate. [7] The plate sits 18 inches behind the center of the mound. [7] Wikipedia's glossary gives the same figure, measured from the rear point of home plate. [5]
